concepts.title: 햇살 드는 호텔 복도에서 걸어오기
concepts.background: 햇살이 길게 드는 밝은 크림색 호텔 복도 한 곳, 가운데 자리
concepts.background_en: A long bright hotel corridor with pale cream walls, light wood floor and tall windows on one side letting in soft sunlight, no people, no signs or lettering. The corridor runs straight away from the camera to a far end.
concepts.framing: 세로, 눈높이, 복도 정면에서 조금 떨어진 거리, 멈출 때 전신이 화면 높이의 약 70%, 카메라 고정
concepts.light: 한낮의 부드러운 햇살, 따뜻한 크림 톤
concepts.why: 블랙·브라운 위주의 겨울 코디라 밝은 크림 복도에서 실루엣과 부츠가 또렷하게 보임. 복도 끝에서 걸어오는 동선
concepts.pace: 보폭 중간, 1초에 약 2걸음, 어깨는 흔들림 없이
concepts.camera_en: Fixed camera at eye height (about 1.5 m), several meters from the stopping spot, no zoom, no shake, no follow.
concepts.pace_en: medium strides, about two steps per second, level shoulders, arms swinging gently, no bobbing
concepts.light_en: Soft midday sunlight from the windows, warm cream tones, same light for every look.
concepts.direction_en: walking from the far end of the corridor straight toward the camera, then exiting to the left

shots.action: 복도 끝에서 카메라 쪽으로 걸어와 멈춰 포즈 후 왼쪽으로 퇴장
shots.pose: 라벤더 호보백 어깨끈을 오른손으로 고쳐 메기
shots.motion_en: One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her motion and hands. 0-2.5s: she walks straight toward the camera down the corridor with medium strides, about two steps per second, shoulders level, arms swinging gently, no bobbing. 2.5-3.5s: she stops at center, full body about 62% of frame height with feet and head well inside the frame. 3.5-4.5s: with her right hand she lifts the lavender hobo bag strap on her shoulder, settles it once, then lets the hand fall, then looks at the camera. 4.5-5.5s: she turns to her left and walks out of frame to the left with the same steady strides.
shots.start: 복도 끝 가운데, 전신이 화면 세로의 약 30%, 걷는 중
shots.start_en: She is at the far end of the corridor, horizontally centered, full body about 30% of frame height, mid-stride with right foot forward and arms hanging naturally, facing the camera. No pose yet.

concepts.title: 밝은 갤러리 홀에서 옷매무새 만지기
concepts.background: 흰 벽과 회색 콘크리트 바닥의 갤러리 홀, 큰 창 앞 한 자리
concepts.background_en: A quiet minimalist gallery hall with plain off-white walls, light gray concrete floor and a large frosted window, soft overcast daylight, no people, no artwork, no signs or lettering.
concepts.framing: 세로, 눈높이, 정면에서 조금 떨어진 거리, 전신이 화면 높이의 약 62%, 카메라 고정
concepts.light: 흐린 날의 차분한 자연광, 뉴트럴 회백색
concepts.why: 블랙·브라운 소재(스웨이드, 퍼)의 질감이 차분한 무채색 배경에서 잘 보임. 걷지 않고 제자리에서 포인트 아이템을 만지는 동작
concepts.camera_en: Fixed camera at eye height, a few meters away, no zoom, no shake, no follow.
concepts.pace_en: she stays on the spot, slow deliberate hand movements, one gesture per look
concepts.light_en: Soft overcast daylight from the window, neutral off-white tones, same light for every look.
concepts.direction_en: standing still facing the camera, no walking

shots.action: 제자리에 서서 옷매무새를 만진 뒤 카메라 보기
shots.pose: 라벤더 호보백 어깨끈을 오른손으로 고쳐 메기
shots.motion_en: One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her motion and hands. 0-1s: she stands still and breathes, then shifts her weight slightly. 1-3s: with her right hand she lifts the lavender hobo bag strap on her shoulder, settles it once, then lets the hand fall. 3-4s: she looks straight at the camera with a soft natural expression. 4-5.5s: she returns to the same standing position as at the start and holds still. She does not walk and stays at the same spot and size.
shots.start: 가운데, 전신이 화면 세로의 약 62%, 정면으로 가만히 선 모습

concepts.title: 해 질 녘 옥상에서 가볍게 춤추기
concepts.background: 해 질 녘 도심 옥상 테라스 한 곳, 연한 베이지 바닥과 낮은 난간
concepts.background_en: A rooftop terrace at sunset with a light beige tiled floor, a low railing and a soft pink-orange sky over a blurred city skyline, no people, no signs or lettering.
concepts.framing: 세로, 눈높이, 정면에서 조금 떨어진 거리, 전신이 화면 높이의 약 62%, 카메라 고정
concepts.light: 해 질 녘 핑크빛 노을, 따뜻하고 부드러운 색감
concepts.why: 노을빛 배경이라 겨울 옷의 분위기가 포근해 보이고, 한 바퀴 돌 때 치마와 코트 자락이 잘 보임
concepts.pace: 제자리 리듬 타기, 1초에 약 2번 몸을 실음
concepts.camera_en: Fixed camera at eye height, a few meters away, no zoom, no shake, no follow.
concepts.pace_en: easy rhythm, about two weight shifts per second, light shoulder bounce, one slow turn
concepts.light_en: Warm pink-orange sunset light, soft and even, same light for every look.
concepts.direction_en: dancing on the spot facing the camera, no walking

shots.action: 제자리에서 리듬 타다 한 바퀴 돌고 포즈
shots.pose: 라벤더 호보백 어깨끈을 오른손으로 고쳐 메기
shots.motion_en: One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her motion and hands. 0-1.5s: she sways to an easy beat, shifting weight left and right about twice per second, shoulders gently bouncing. 1.5-3s: she does one slow turn on the spot. 3-4s: facing the camera, with her right hand she lifts the lavender hobo bag strap on her shoulder, settles it once, then lets the hand fall. 4-5.5s: she sways lightly and returns to the starting stance. She stays at the same spot and size, never steps out of frame.
